response:
Okay, for Part A, I need to use 1 triangle and 1 trapezoid to make a 4-sided figure. I'll put the triangle pointing up, and then I'll put the trapezoid next to it, with the longer side of the trapezoid touching the bottom side of the triangle. I'll draw it on the grid. 

I would draw the triangle pointing upwards. Then, I would place the trapezoid below the triangle so that its longer side (the base of 2 triangles) is touching the bottom edge of the triangle. The trapezoid's shorter side (the base of 1 triangle) would be facing away from the triangle. This creates a 4-sided figure that looks kind of like a house.
